description: Accounts Bluesky's AppView withholds that a community this AppView lists still hosts and has not banned, served from what this AppView stores.

restored.description: The marker carried by the view of every such account and its posts (profileViewBasic, profileView, profileViewDetailed, postView including feedViewPost.reply.parent and .root and threadViewPost.post, and embed.record#viewRecord), in every response of this AppView. Absent means the subject is not one. Never on a gap node, notFoundPost, blockedPost or viewNotFound.

community.description: The name of the community that hosts the account, as the operator listed it.

tier.description: 1: the community runs an AppView; 2: it runs a labeler.

labeler.description: The community's labeler, when it has one. Its labels on these views carry it as their src.
